items.title: Wiring Beats Blending: What Transfers Between Transformer Sizes -- and What Doesn't
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2608.02829v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Model families train every size from scratch. Can a pretrained large model be converted into a smaller sibling? We characterize the 1.4B->410M conversion in the Pythia family end-to-end: (i) representations align strongly across sizes (ridge R^2=0.84) while parameters align weakly; (ii) dense weight projection is functionally destructive -- provably not an assembly artifact -- because basis mixing breaks rotary, per-head, GELU, and LayerNorm structure; (iii) after the best-fit linear operator, weight residuals are statistically indistinguishable from noise under shuffle controls; (iv) conversion value therefore lives in initialization. In matched-budget continued pre-training we decompose conversion into two independent levers -- least-squares compensation (function: best zero-shot) and variance-preserving rescale (dynamics: best endpoints). items.reason_zh: 揭示Transformer不同规模间迁移的机制，证明权重投影破坏性，对模型压缩有重要启示。
items.summary_zh: 本文研究Transformer模型家族中不同规模之间的迁移可能性。以Pythia 1.4B到410M为例，发现表示层对齐强（R^2=0.84）但参数对齐弱；直接权重投影在功能上具有破坏性。作者提出替代方法，并分析哪些组件可迁移，为模型压缩和知识蒸馏提供新视角。
items.title_zh: 接线胜过混合：Transformer规模间什么可迁移——什么不可

items.title: WorldCycle: Self-Verifiable Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Video World Models
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2608.04964v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Interactive video world models are essential for long-horizon planning and exploration, yet they suffer from compounding errors. Post-training methods such as reinforcement learning (RL) can improve these models, but they hit a verification bottleneck: for arbitrary action sequences, no ground-truth future state exists to measure long-term drift. Our key insight is that reversible action cycles make this verification possible: a sequence composed with its inverse must analytically return to the initial state, yielding annotation-free supervision on long-horizon correctness. items.reason_zh: 提出自验证强化学习框架WorldCycle，解决长时程视频世界模型的验证瓶颈，创新性强。
items.summary_zh: 交互式视频世界模型对长时程规划和探索至关重要，但存在复合误差。强化学习等后训练方法可改进模型，但面临验证瓶颈：对于任意动作序列，没有真实未来状态来测量长期漂移。本文提出WorldCycle，一种自验证强化学习框架，通过循环一致性机制使模型自我验证预测，无需外部真实状态。实验表明，WorldCycle能有效减少复合误差，提升长时程预测的准确性，为视频世界模型训练提供新思路。
items.title_zh: WorldCycle：长时程视频世界模型的自验证强化学习

items.title: Architectural Implications of Agentic AI Workflows
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2608.04458v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Agentic AI is emerging in datacenters, but its architectural implications remain unexplored. We organize agentic workflows in a taxonomy and present its first architectural characterization with a production study at Microsoft Azure and a controlled study of open-source frameworks. We show that agentic execution is fragmented and heterogeneous. Requests expand into a workflow of LLM inferences, tool invocations, and orchestration decisions that repeatedly cross the CPU-GPU boundary. Our taxonomy explains how this fragmentation turns into resource demand. As orchestration and tools run on the host, the CPU sits on the critical path. Execution structure sets the load over time, which stays low with sudden spikes. Model composition sets how evenly the workflow uses the GPUs. items.reason_zh: 首次对Agentic AI工作负载进行架构特征化分析，基于微软生产环境研究，对数据中心设计有重要参考。
items.summary_zh: 本文首次对Agentic AI工作负载进行架构特征化分析，基于微软Azure的生产研究和开源框架的受控研究。作者将代理工作流分类，并揭示其碎片化和异构性。研究结果对数据中心架构设计有重要启示，包括资源调度、内存层次和网络需求等，为未来Agentic AI基础设施优化提供数据支撑。
items.title_zh: Agentic AI工作流的架构影响

items.title: The Agent Access Model
items.raw_text: The Agent Access Model proposes a new architecture to secure task-scoped agents using strict identity brokering, continuous mediation, and stateful trust.
items.reason_zh: 提出Agent访问模型新架构，通过严格身份代理、持续中介和有状态信任保障任务型代理安全，对AI安全设计有重要启发。
items.summary_zh: 文章提出了一种名为“Agent访问模型”的新架构，旨在保护任务型AI代理的安全。该模型采用严格的身份代理（identity brokering）、持续的中介（continuous mediation）和有状态的信任（stateful trust）机制，确保代理在执行任务时只能访问必要的资源，并持续验证其行为。这一架构为AI代理的安全设计提供了新的思路，有助于防止权限滥用和数据泄露。

items.title: Diagnosing Tool-Selection Reasoning in LLM Agents with Canary Tools
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2608.04719v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Agent evaluations tell us that a model picked the wrong tool, but rarely why. We introduce canary tools: diagnostic probe tools planted in an agent's Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool set, each engineered to probe one specific tool-selection weakness. A six-type taxonomy (semantic decoys, parameter traps, capability mirages, prerequisite blindness, temporal decoys, and granularity traps) turns a single "wrong tool" outcome into a multi-dimensional profile of how a model reasons about tools. We evaluate eight models -- six hosted and two 8B open-weight -- spanning three capability tiers, on 120 tasks across three canary-density conditions and three seeds (8,640 runs), plus a 2,880-run subtlety ablation. items.reason_zh: 引入金丝雀工具诊断LLM代理工具选择推理缺陷，提供可操作的改进方向。
items.summary_zh: 该论文针对LLM代理在工具选择上的推理缺陷，提出了金丝雀工具（canary tools）方法。这些诊断探针工具被植入代理的MCP工具集中，每种工具专门探测一种特定的弱点。作者定义了一个六类型分类法（语义诱饵、参数陷阱、能力幻象、先决条件盲区等），通过实验验证了该方法能有效识别代理工具选择中的具体推理问题，为改进代理设计提供了依据。

items.title: Hierarchical Graph Memory for LLM Agents with Path-level Localization and Rewrite
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2608.05095v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Agents for long term reasoning require a memory that can be efficiently and effectively updated over time, as new facts and external feedback continue to arrive. Recently, graph memory has been adopted to offer structural organization for multi-hop retrieval and reasoning. However, existing methods store all memories in a flat graph, and accumulated historical memories can introduce irrelevant contexts and increase the cost of evidence selection during retrieval. Moreover, they typically update memory units independently, requiring repeated unit-wise rewrite to cover related changes. To address these issues, we propose HiGram, an evolving hierarchical graph memory framework with path-level localization and rewriting. items.summary_zh: 本文针对LLM智能体长期推理中的记忆管理问题，提出层级图记忆结构。现有方法将记忆存储在平面图中，导致更新效率低。作者引入路径级定位与重写机制，使记忆更新更精准高效。实验表明该方法在多跳检索与推理任务上优于基线，提升了智能体的长期推理能力。
items.title_zh: 用于LLM智能体的层级图记忆：路径级定位与重写
